name: A New Plague
summary: In Brill, A New Plague reaches its first test on a captive dwarf. Apothecary Johaan sends you to Gallows' End Tavern cellar with the brew he has made from reagents gathered across Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: A Deadly Concoction
sections.body: Apothecary Johaan has brought his research to a dangerous trial. The Royal Apothecary Society works for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, seeking a plague that kills the living while bypassing undead bodies. Johaan has brewed what he calls a “special drink” and sends you to give it to an imprisoned enemy of the Forsaken.

sections.title: The Gallows' End Cellar
sections.body: The Deathguard holds captives in a damp cellar beneath Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, where they await interrogation or disposal. One prisoner is a Dwarven Mountaineer, an Ironforge scout caught trespassing in Tirisfal Glades. Defiant and thirsty, he eagerly accepts the drink, unaware of what Johaan has mixed into it.

sections.title: A Chilling Demonstration
sections.body: The captured mountaineer drinks the flask and wistfully compares it to Rhapsody Malt. He boasts that dwarven steam tanks are coming to save him. The poison kills him almost at once. Johaan's final words make clear that this deadly brew is only a taste of what the Dark Lady envisions for the rest of Azeroth.

faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan is a Royal Apothecary Society member stationed in Brill, Tirisfal Glades. He directs early work on a plague for Forsaken warfare and has adventurers gather lethal reagents from the surrounding wilderness.

faq.q: Why is there a dwarf captured in Brill?
faq.answer: Ironforge Mountaineers scout the northern kingdoms to watch Forsaken movements and investigate the plaguelands. The Deathguard caught this scout in Tirisfal and locked him in the tavern cellar until the apothecaries found a use for him.

faq.q: What happens when you give the prisoner the drink?
faq.answer: The dwarf gladly takes the flagon, thirsty after his capture. The toxic brew kills him moments after he drinks it, showing the force of Johaan's latest plague formulation.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the New Plague research?
faq.answer: The Forsaken seek a new plague under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner's orders. They aim to make a weapon that can destroy both the mindless Scourge and the living races that threaten their territory.

faq.q: Where is the Captured Mountaineer located?
faq.answer: The Captured Mountaineer is held in the cellar downstairs at Gallows' End Tavern, in the center of Brill in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Does this quest chain continue beyond this dwarf?
faq.answer: Johaan's four-part assignment ends with the mountaineer's death. Research into the New Plague continues across Lordaeron, with further testing in the Undercity and the Sepulcher.

angles.text: As an undead, you see the Forsaken's uncompromising struggle to survive and the lethal work of the Royal Apothecary Society.
As a dwarf, you see how far Ironforge Mountaineers range to watch Tirisfal Glades, risking death and covert interrogation.
As an Alliance member, you see the ruthlessness the Forsaken show toward Alliance intruders found in Lordaeron.
As a Horde member, you see the Forsaken pursue victory through cold alchemical warfare, even against friend or foe.
